All three files are wired up:

- [MediaImagePage.tsx](src/shared/components/media-viewer-modal/MediaImagePage.tsx) — wrapped in `memo`, decrypt effect keyed on `eventId` via a `loadRef`, callback signature now `(eventId, uri)`.
- [MediaVideoPage.tsx](src/shared/components/media-viewer-modal/MediaVideoPage.tsx) — same memo + ref pattern; `isActive` still drives the lazy load and pause behavior so swiped-into videos start fetching only when active.
- [MediaViewerModalContent.tsx](src/shared/components/media-viewer-modal/MediaViewerModalContent.tsx#L257-L260) — passes the stable `handleLocalUriChange` directly (no inline lambda); FlatList now `initialNumToRender={1}`, `maxToRenderPerBatch={1}`, `windowSize={3}`, `removeClippedSubviews`.

Net effect: opening the viewer now decrypts only the tapped page; swiping decrypts neighbors one at a time. Memoized pages skip re-renders when `currentIndex` changes — only the video flipping its `isActive` state actually re-renders.

content.text:
I see the bug now. Two compounding issues:

1. The modal opens with `mediaItems = []`, so `events = [initialEvent]`, `findIndex` returns 0, FlatList mounts with `initialScrollIndex=0`. When `mediaItems` hydrates, `initialPageIndex` updates — but FlatList is already mounted at 0 (initialScrollIndex only applies on first mount).

2. The MediaGallery has been auto-paginating in the background and has many items loaded. The modal creates its **own** timeline (via `useMediaTimeline`) starting fresh, so its first page (50 items) may not include the tapped event for items deeper in the list.

Fix: keep showing only `[initialEvent]` until the modal's timeline has paginated far enough to include the tapped event, auto-paginate while we wait, and remount the FlatList once it appears so `initialScrollIndex` resolves correctly.

Three changes in [MediaViewerModalContent.tsx](src/shared/components/media-viewer-modal/MediaViewerModalContent.tsx):

1. **`hasInitialEvent`** ([:78-82](src/shared/components/media-viewer-modal/MediaViewerModalContent.tsx#L78-L82)) — gates whether the modal's own timeline has paginated far enough to include the tapped event.

Net behavior: tap any item — viewer immediately shows the seed, paginates in the background, then snaps to the correct index once the full list contains the event.
